title: GIRDER ROAD DASH
notes: Exact ROAD-section DASH page lists ¥18,800; sizes S (448 mm), M (459 mm), L (497 mm); T700+T800 endurance frame and fork, EPS molding, fully hidden routing, 12 mm thru-axles; T700+T800 integrated bar; Ultegra FC-R8100 52-36T 170 mm, R8170 Di2 2×12, R8170 hydraulic discs, CN-M8100, CS-R8100 11-34T; in-house ceramic BB ('PF386 to T47 tool interface'); Selle Italia saddle and tape; Adler Augen wavy-rim ceramic-bearing wheels 50/50 mm; Maxxis M228 700C×28C skinwall with TPU tubes; weight 8.3 kg (basis not stated). Not the NEW 2025 DASH (NEW2025/36.html, T800+T1000 all-round, ¥22,800). ROAD-section bikes share T700+T800 carbon and press-fit shells and do not share a frame with NEW 2025 bikes of the same name.
